ownership: Nebraska DHHS Public Health Informatics; service hosted by Nebraska GIS
allowed_use: Conditional internal source-contract metadata and fixed aggregate assessment after the separately recorded scope decision validates
prohibited_use: Facility-row, object-ID, or feature export; home-provider enumeration; purchase; reCAPTCHA automation; public redistribution; current-operation, completeness, ZIP coverage, geocoding, or national coverage claims
attribution: DHHS DPH Licensure, DHHS GIS; DHHS Licensed Child Care via NebraskaMAP
retention: Only exact metadata anchors, aggregate counts/date-only extrema, request status/byte/hash metadata, and immutable intent/receipt/manifest are retained internally; no raw response bodies.
redistribution: No public data or provider export authorized; output is a prerequisite observation only.
policy_evidence: DHHS public-use item notice and linked Nebraska.gov automation/copying policy have unresolved applicability to automated access; no scope decision is included or presumed.
temporal_limits: Observed source cohort dated 2025-10-15 (699 Child Care Center; 51 Provisional Child Care Center); not current 2026 evidence and not current operations.
